style: Dark, melancholic 1980s sci-fi film synth score for a lonely retro pixel-art space game, deep space ambient: slow-evolving retro analog synthesizer pads with filter sweeps, a soft low 16th-note arpeggiator, a sub-bass drone on a pedal tone, a sparse lonely lead with slow vibrato, tape echo and vast reverb, lots of space, dusty electric piano, muted glass plucks, a subdued bass pedal and small mechanical relay clicks. A dim salvage exchange above the cloud floor, a place to trade quietly and remember the missing. Wry and introspective, suspended and minor, tired night-shift melancholy. Purely instrumental. Am, 94 BPM.
